title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 Commercial / Contracts
 



**Direct report:** 
 Contract Manager/Contract Assistant
 



**Key interfaces:** 
 Senior leadership, Project Directors, Business Development, Finance, \& Bid Management Reporting), Legal advisers, Insurers, Clients, Sub\-Consultants
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The Senior Contracts Manager leads the company's contracts function and is accountable for how it manages contractual and commercial risk. The role sets the contract strategy, standards and governance for the team, negotiates and approves key contract terms, leads on variations, claims and disputes, and makes sure management receives accurate, timely contract information to support decisions.
 



  





 The Senior Contracts Manager line\-manages the Contract Manager/Assistant. Day\-to\-day contract administration is delegated to the Contract Manager, while the Senior Contracts Manager provides oversight, assistance with Contractual Agreements, approval, escalation and development of the team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Contract Strategy and Commercial Risk** 



* Review and advise on the contract terms of major bids and awards before signature, including scope, fees, payment terms, liability caps, indemnities, insurance, intellectual property and termination provisions.
* Lead negotiations with clients on high\-value, high\-risk or non\-standard contracts, and recommend acceptance, qualification or rejection of terms to senior leadership.
* Establish and maintain the company's risk appetite for contract terms, including approval thresholds and escalation routes.



  





**Governance, Standards and Approvals** 



* Own the company's standard contract templates, including SCAs, LOAs, PO terms and standard qualifications for proposals.
* Approve contracts, sub\-consultant agreements and variations above the Contract Manager's delegated authority.
* Set and enforce contract procedures, record\-keeping standards and data quality rules across the contract, award, bid and finance trackers, Cleverflow and Metabase.
* Carry out periodic audits of contract records and trackers to confirm accuracy and compliance.



  





**Variations, Claims and Disputes** 



* Lead the company's position on significant variation orders (VOs), fee adjustments, extensions of time and claims, making sure entitlement is protected and properly documented.
* Manage contractual disputes with clients and sub\-consultants, working with legal advisers where needed, and aim for negotiated resolution.
* Ensure lessons learned from disputes and claims feed back into contract templates and bid qualifications.



  





**Management Reporting and Decision Support** 



* Sign off the contract and award data prepared for the
 **weekly Wednesday management meeting** 
 , and present key issues, risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Give senior leadership oversight of the award pipeline, contract status, outstanding contracts and commercial exposure.
* Work with Finance leadership so that contract status and VO information support accurate WIP, revenue forecasting and cash\-flow planning.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the senior contractual point of contact for key clients, and the escalation point for long\-outstanding contracts or disputed matters.
* Manage relationships with legal advisers and insurers, including professional indemnity insurance requirements under client contracts.
* Support the Head of Bids and Business Development on the contractual aspects of bids, frameworks and joint ventures.



  





**Team Leadership and Development** 



* Line\-manage the Contract Manager, setting objectives, reviewing performance and supporting professional development.
* Oversee workload across the contracts team so that recurring deadlines (Friday bid tracker, Wednesday management pack) are consistently met.
* Build contract awareness across project teams through guidance and training on key contract obligations.
* Plan for resourcing and succession in the contracts function as the business grows.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




  




* Contract execution \- Percentage of awarded projects with fully executed contracts within the target period
* Commercial risk \- Contracts signed within approved risk parameters; number of exceptions approved
* Data accuracy \- Reconciliation discrepancies between, Cleverflow Metabase, trackers and finance records
* Reporting \- Management pack and bid tracker delivered on time every week
* Variations and claims \- Value and timeliness of VOs agreed; claims recovered
* Disputes \- Number, duration and outcome of contractual disputes
* Team \- Team performance, development and retention



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  





**Education and Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, Law or a related field. A postgraduate qualification in construction law or contract management is an advantage.
* 10–15 years of experience in contract or commercial management, including at least 5 years in a senior or team\-leading role, ideally within an engineering, design or construction consultancy.
* Proven track record of negotiating consultancy agreements and managing variations, claims and disputes.
* Substantial GCC/UAE experience, including work with government and major developer clients.



  





**Professional Membership (Desirable)** 



* MRICS, MCIArb, FIDIC certification, or equivalent professional recognition.



  





**Knowledge and Skills** 



* Expert knowledge of consultancy and construction contract forms, including the FIDIC suite (particularly the White Book for consultancy services) and bespoke client agreements.
* Good understanding of UAE/KSA contract and commercial law principles, professional indemnity insurance and liability management.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder management skills at senior level.
* Ability to interpret financial and commercial data and link it to contract positions.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including preparation of board\-level reports.



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Commercially astute, with sound judgement on risk.
* Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly in negotiations and disputes.
* Sets high standards for accuracy and governance,and leads by example.

**Position:** 
**Senior Manager – Moulding \& Tool Maintenance** 




**Department:** 
 Moulding
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Plant Head
 



**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala, India
 



**Position Summary:** 




 Provide strategic and operational leadership for a high\-technology, high\-volume Moulding operation supporting precision electronic connector manufacturing. Lead a manufacturing footprint of 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies with advanced automation.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance of the Moulding function, including manufacturing operations, process engineering, automation, capacity planning, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery, while building and managing a robust external moulding ecosystem through vendor development, job work, and purchase models.
 



 Develop a high\-quality, technically capable, cost\-competitive, and scalable moulding vendor network to support business growth, capacity flexibility, localization, and supply continuity. Establish strong technical and commercial governance for outsourced moulding, ensuring consistent quality, competitive total cost, delivery reliability, process capability, and adherence to global manufacturing standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. High\-Tech Moulding Operations** 



* Lead a high\-volume Moulding shopfloor comprising 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies.
* Drive performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, OEE, Productivity, Yield, and Capacity Utilization.
* Optimize moulding processes, cycle times, machine utilization, material consumption, changeovers, and process stability.
* Drive advanced automation, robotics, vision systems, process monitoring, and digital manufacturing solutions.
* Establish robust manufacturing standards to ensure consistent and capable processes.



  





**2\. Moulding Vendor Development \& External Manufacturing** 



* Develop and maintain a strategic network of capable moulding vendors to support internal capacity and business growth.
* Identify, evaluate, technically assess, qualify, and develop new moulding vendors based on technology, capacity, quality systems, process capability, scalability, and cost competitiveness.
* Develop vendors capable of meeting stringent requirements for precision electronic connector components.
* Establish structured vendor capability assessment, qualification, process validation, and performance\-monitoring systems.
* Develop alternate sources and a resilient vendor base to mitigate capacity, quality, and supply risks.
* Drive continuous improvement of vendor capability through technical support, process audits, quality improvement initiatives, and performance reviews.



  





**3\. Job Work \& Purchase Model Management** 



* Develop and implement appropriate job\-work and purchase models based on product characteristics, capacity requirements, cost competitiveness, and strategic sourcing considerations.
* Evaluate the optimal make\-versus\-buy / internal\-versus\-external manufacturing approach for moulding requirements.
* Establish clear commercial, technical, quality, and delivery expectations for outsourced moulding.
* Drive cost\-effective external manufacturing without compromising product quality, process capability, IP protection, delivery, or customer requirements.
* Monitor and optimize the overall economics of outsourced moulding, including conversion cost, material utilization, logistics, tooling utilization, and total landed cost.
* Ensure effective capacity allocation between internal operations and external manufacturing partners.



  





**4\. Vendor Quality \& Process Capability** 



* Establish stringent quality and process capability requirements for all moulding vendors.
* Drive First\-Time\-Right, defect prevention, process capability, yield improvement, and reduction of customer\-related quality issues.
* Conduct regular supplier process audits and capability assessments.
* Ensure effective implementation of PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, process validation, and structured problem\-solving at key vendors.
* Lead supplier corrective and preventive actions for quality and delivery issues.
* Establish vendor scorecards covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Capacity, Responsiveness, and Continuous Improvement.



  





**5\. Cost Competitiveness** 



* Drive a cost\-efficient moulding ecosystem through competitive sourcing, productivity improvement, process optimization, automation, and vendor development.
* Benchmark internal and external conversion costs and identify cost\-reduction opportunities.
* Develop competitive commercial models for job work and purchased moulded components.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to ensure transparency and competitiveness of moulding costs.
* Drive annual cost\-reduction and productivity initiatives across the internal and external moulding network.



  





**6\. Capacity \& Business Continuity** 



* Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term moulding capacity strategies aligned with business growth and customer demand.
* Balance internal capacity with external vendor capacity to provide flexibility, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Establish contingency and alternate\-source strategies for critical components.
* Ensure vendor capacity readiness for new product launches, volume ramps, and demand fluctuations.



  





**7\. New Product Introduction \& Industrialization** 



* Partner with Engineering, NPI, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for successful industrialization of new moulded connector components.
* Assess manufacturability and external manufacturing feasibility during product development.
* Lead vendor selection, capability assessment, trials, validation, and production ramp\-up for outsourced moulding.
* Ensure new vendors and processes achieve required quality, capability, cost, and delivery targets before production release.



  





**8\. Operational Excellence \& Technology** 



* Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Kaizen, automation, and digital manufacturing across internal and external moulding operations.
* Benchmark advanced moulding technologies and global manufacturing practices.
* Promote data\-driven decision\-making and real\-time performance monitoring.
* Drive continuous improvement in OEE, yield, cycle time, scrap, energy consumption, and conversion cost.



  





**9\. People \& Leadership** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team across Moulding Operations, Process Engineering, and Moulding Vendor Development.
* Build strong technical capability in injection moulding, automation, process engineering, supplier development, and external manufacturing.
* Develop a culture of accountability, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and Global Operations.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed institution.
* A postgraduate qualification in Manufacturing, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field is an added advantage.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in high\-volume injection moulding / plastics manufacturing, preferably within automotive, electronics, electrical, connector, or precision component manufacturing.
* Strong hands\-on and leadership experience in vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies, preferably with automated manufacturing systems.



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Moulding OEE and capacity utilization
* Quality / PPM / First\-Pass Yield
* Internal and external moulding productivity
* Cycle\-time and scrap reduction
* Moulding conversion cost
* Vendor Quality and On\-Time Delivery
* Vendor capability and capacity readiness
* Vendor development / localization
* Job\-work and purchase\-model optimization
* Make\-versus\-buy effectiveness
* New product industrialization performance
* Cost\-reduction and productivity savings
* Automation and digitalization deployment
* Supply continuity and alternate\-source readiness

* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to engage, as a thought leader, senior executives of the firm, in cross business discussions within a matrixed, geographically dispersed organization and to build a solid network of peers and others of influence. Uses these relationships to connect colleagues, challenge insightfully to improve processes and propose credible options
* Well defined consultative skills to conduct effective questioning , hone in on key issues to formulate ideas and materials as well as present those ideas clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization including senior and/or executive management

Being the go\-to MEP/CIVIL person
   

  

 Are you considered to be the go\-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL\-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL\-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
   

  

 Making visions come true
   

  

 You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
   

  

 While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
   

  

 Building strong teams and business reputation
   

  

 One of your priorities will be to produce high\-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
   

  

 Keeping risks at bay
   

  

 How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health \& safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.

 An MEP/CIVIL pro
   

  

 You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering\-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.

Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
   

  

 A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
   

  

 You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.

 A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
